inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The grass on the playground was overgrown.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less: The exit to one of the silides in the Toddler playground is less that six-feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less (26 TAC §746.4805(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 2 children's records were missing health statements for their records
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver was missing five clock hours on their annual training requirement hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Eight out of nine children files were missing information on health statements, special needs, emergency medical attention, release of children, emergency contact address, and parent s rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: Director was missing two out thirty clock hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who ceased employment in 2025 by the required date of January 15, 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The grass area on the playground was out grown.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The infant room was observed of having dead cockroaches and debris behind the shelves, milk crate, child size sofa, sitting stools, and between the wall and cabinet.   There was a dead cricket in the dining hall under the rolling cart.   There were dead cockroaches and crickets on the floor with collected debris. There was a spider with its spider web on the windowsill, dust and dead cockroach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: There was a basket filled with monster trucks designated for  children ages 3 years and older.   The youngest child in the classroom was two years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2501(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: The operation does not have liability insurance and   they had no proof of notifying the parents that the opeation does not currently have liability insurance.       Note. The parent handbook has a date stamp of 9/19/2025  of being modified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §746.207(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The infant caregiver walked out of the classroom to open the front door, leaving two infants alone while they were sleeping in their cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: The toddler classroom has a diaper changing station and no hand wash sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: The toddler classroom is currently under renovations and has been moved to another room where there is no hand wash sink. There is a diaper changing station in the classroom in which caregiver stated they use hand sanitizer after diapering.   Note. A portable hand wash sink was added to the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The infant room was observed of having dead cockroaches on the floor and window seal, spider webs, used Q-tip, and debris on long the side of the wall and also on one crib mattress.   There were other classrooms also with dead cockroaches on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The infant area  has two rooms adjacent; one side with cribs and the other with toys, infant furniture and diaper changing station. The room with the cribs was dark during naptime and had two infants sleeping in their cribs.      Note. This was corrected when the caregiver opened the curtain to allow light in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There was a hole on the wall exposing electrical wires to an outlet. This poses a risk to any infant, but especially the one who is laid down on a crib within hands reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: The toddler classroom  for 18-23 month old children had magnetic Bingo chips designated for ages 3 and up.       Note. Although the classroom has a combine group of children ages 2 -4 years old, the classroom is still considered and approved for the toddler children. Therefore, the toys and equipment must meet age appropriate guidelines.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2501(5))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: The restrooms located in the hallway did not have soap in the dispensers.     Note. This was corrected at inspection when the soap dispenser was refilled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: At the time of the walk through inspection, a group of children in the infant classroom were observed having screen time. One child was two years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: The operation does not have liability insurance and there was no posting or any other notification  staying they have no liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §746.207(a))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The operation recently had their chain link fence replaced, leaving several areas with at least a 10-inch gap from ground to fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: The trash can in classroom #5  had the lid removed and found inside the can. There was a  trash bag filled with garbage that was not taken out  on the last operating business day.     Classroom #4 was observed with  several different sizes of dead  cockroaches on the table, tile floor and rugs.        Note. This was corrected at inspection when the trash bag was removed and replaced with a new bag and lid placed over the can.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: At the time of inspection, one infant did not have a current feeding log for the month of June. The infant went from drinking breast milk to formula.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver disregarded the feeding log a parent had recently updated for the month of April and served an 8-month-old infant cranberry juice. The juice was not listed on the feeding log.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: An infant's feeding instruction was not followed when a staff served an infant cranberry juice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: There were no feeding logs available for review in the infant classroom for infants not yet eating table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infants feeding instructions were filled with information on the type of formula, number of bottles and ounces to service, but did not have the date and parent signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: The files of three out of four children were reviewed and had missing vaccinations according to their age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The transportation van did not have the child safety alarm in operating conditions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: The staff files were reviewed and found incomplete. Staff did not have the required annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Six out of seven staff files reviewed did not have annual training hours. One of those staff files was the infant caregiver who did not have SID's, Shaken Baby, Brain Development and Child Maltreat training.
